status: New game rendering; owner art approval is separate from technical validation. Original source/model sheets retained.
method: New drawn poses, unchanged original generated PNGs; registered isolated alpha spans, a single scale per hero and independently reviewed full-face probes.
reference_policy: Owner model references and existing original sheets determine identity. The inline black-cat image informs pixel clusters/material lighting only; no cat pixels, outfit or species are incorporated. Private references are not republished.

identities.aion: Pink axolotl; cyan-tipped pink gills, blue eyes, white scientist coat/badges and DNA tail.
identities.owl: Orange/brown owl; cream facial disk/chest, amber eyes, feathered wings and yellow beak/talons.
identities.sheep: Cream wool sheep; amber eyes, drooping ears, brown hooves and gold halo.
identities.wolf: Purple/gray wolf; cyan eyes, cream muzzle/chest/tailtip, purple forearm rune; no shirt or lab coat.
identities.rabbit: Emre: tan rabbit, green eyes, blue shirt/plain red tie, dark trousers, bare rabbit feet.
identities.eren: Eren: orange-brown rabbit, dark plum eyes/black eyelashes, freckles, spiky cheek tufts, dark teal jacket/striped tie, brown shoes.

playback_note: Rows0..10 are the 396 unique authored source drawings. Virtual row11 reuses four forward-fall drawings per hero for enemy faceplants; it is not counted as new artwork.
